licence.note: Authorized local prototype transfer only. User supply does not establish public distribution rights; original rights holder not verified.

usage: Local prototype assets only; not approved for public export, publication or redistribution.
originalPathBase: Original user-supplied asset collection (relative paths only; no private absolute locations retained).
transfer: Byte-for-byte copies of exactly 22 explicit roster PNG files. No image transformation during transfer; original import transformations below are inherited from source provenance.

metadataNotes.names: Base five use the exact playable roster names from index.html; expanded entries use exact expanded-sprites.js names. Provenance retains playable roster spellings separately where different.

facing.basis: index.html passes u.facing<0 to all sprite draw paths; drawLancerSprite, drawBelindaSprite and team-sprite-renderer.js mirror the horizontal scale only when flip is true. No per-hero direction/flip metadata or importer mirroring was found.
facing.limitation: Right-facing is the source renderer convention for all 22 heroes, not an independently visually verified claim about every image or frame. Static-reference portraits have no authored movement direction.

metadataNotes.geometry: width/height are full PNG dimensions. cellWidth is 181 for Estrilda, 256 for every other hero. Clip groundY is relative to each clip rectangle, not the full PNG.
metadataNotes.scale: Estrilda and Belinda use their config.js SpriteScale values. Team atlases use teamSpriteScale. Expanded entries preserve source metadata.scale verbatim; those values describe the importer body scale already applied to the packed PNG and are not a mandate to rescale runtime rendering again.
metadataNotes.fps: Generic defaults: idle 8, run 12, attack/hit 15, death 12, skills 12. Estrilda and Belinda retain all per-clip FPS overrides from config.js. The source generic renderer uses teamActionFPS for skill playback; this package intentionally uses the requested generic skill default of 12 rather than asserting exact renderer timing fidelity.
metadataNotes.aliases: Source aliases and all original named clips, including skill4 where supplied, are retained. Added run aliases reuse idle geometry where no confirmed run row exists; generic skill reuses the source renderer's fallback preference skillAura, then skill1, then attack. Added aliases are metadata only, not new authored animation or mechanics.
metadataNotes.limitations: Static-reference Cecilia and Eluard, Oscar idle-action fallback, Morrow/Palmer shared cast rows, excluded VFX-only cells and clipped effect margins remain limitations. No skills are implemented by this package.
metadataNotes.hashes: source.sha256 hashes the local PNG copied from the source prototype; original.sha256 is the recorded hash of the pre-import user-supplied image. Original external files were not read. Estrilda is recorded as an unchanged source copy; its original hash is the copied PNG hash.
